hypothesis: Train shared NCN features for competence-anchored mean-logit performance after private learning on endpoint-separated TRAIN queries; recompute private updates at new shared state before committing.

method.served_score: arithmetic mean of raw member logits
method.outer_objective: 0.5 BCE(mean raw logits)+0.5 mean member BCE, at dropout-off adapted routes on episode support
method.inner_objective: own member BCE normalized within member
method.private_optimizer_state: Original state held constant during current-step derivative; virtual state discarded; recomputed step at theta_plus committed once
method.persistent_weights: theta_plus and recomputed phi_plus(theta_plus); no unadapted base heads served
method.NCNC_extension: Not admitted under exact derivative claim; detached completion requires declared surrogate contract and source qualification

graph_task_definition.outer_queries: Declared native TRAIN query generator, independent of scores
graph_task_definition.inner_queries: TRAIN queries with neither endpoint in outer endpoint set
graph_task_definition.support: Remove union of inner/outer positive target query edges; remaining observed TRAIN graph context retained
graph_task_definition.spanning_edges: Excluded from inner supervision if touching outer endpoint; non-target observed edges can remain context
graph_task_definition.dependence_limit: Single-graph conditional training regularizer, not independent tasks or unbiased cross-fitting
graph_task_definition.historical_label_limit: Outer labels may have influenced previous TRAIN updates; no independent validation claim
graph_task_definition.hub_limit: Inner rejection and fallback/exposure must be declared and reported; do not condition outer sampling on easy feasibility

new_primary_method_scopes.title: Rapid Learning or Feature Reuse? Towards Understanding the Effectiveness of MAML
new_primary_method_scopes.conclusion: ANIL directly precedes head-only inner adaptation and second-order shared feature meta-learning; no new meta-operator claim.

new_primary_method_scopes.title: Meta-Graph: Few shot Link Prediction via Meta Learning
new_primary_method_scopes.conclusion: Related multiple graphs are actual tasks; its assumption does not certify artificial endpoint blocks within one graph. Link-prediction meta-learning already exists.

new_primary_method_scopes.title: Bayesian Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning
new_primary_method_scopes.conclusion: Ensemble meta-learning and shared feature extractor/private classifiers with head-only inner/meta feature updates explicitly precede this proposal; EMAML shares that setup. Broad shared meta-ensemble novelty is contradicted.

what_is_new_in_this_program: Ongoing endpoint-separated, persistent-route, raw-logit graph learning criterion with paid private recomputation and exact serving-state alignment; conditional composition utility hypothesis.
theory_limit: Conditional standard smooth-objective gradient descent for the episode committed state after recomputation. No native Adam, ranking, generalization or universal-superiority guarantee.
strong_controls: capable single with identical adaptation schedule/objective
independent4 with identical ensemble transfer rule
identical shared schedule with detached virtual-private derivative
ordinary training with identical target masking
falsification: No replicated served quality gain over both competent single and independent ensemble leaves accuracy claim unsupported
Detached derivative matching removes adaptation-credit attribution
Random separation matching removes endpoint-specific attribution
Adapted single matching supports generic meta-regularization rather than ensemble benefit
BCE/diversity/competence/storage changes cannot substitute for served ranking improvement
cost_contract: Predeclared U, b_in, b_out, state/RNG/masking conventions and selector. Full all-member virtual inner, adapted eval outer, higher-order backward, inner recomputation, memory/retries/fallbacks/time; matched complete-budget ordinary controls.
